records.title: NATIONAL HIGHWAY PROJECTS IN MANIPUR
details: c: The work for strengthening of the existing pavement from km 0.00 to km 15.35 and km 30.00 to km 45.00 of NH-137A has been sanctioned on 21.10.2025 at an estimated cost of Rs. 74.22 crore.

records.title: Power Generation in North-Eastern Region
details:
(c) : Presently, 3 nos. of Hydro Electric projects (above 25 MW capacity) with total
capacity of 5,000 MW are under construction in Arunachal Pradesh and Assam.
 Further, 16 nos. of Hydro Electric projects with total capacity of 14,069 MW have been concurred by Central Electricity Authority (CEA) and are yet to be taken up for construction in the North-Eastern Region.

records.title: NHPC Power Stations/Plants in North Eastern Region
details:
Part (e): NHPC is currently constructing four hydroelectric/multipurpose projects with a combined
capacity of 5,500 MW in North East region. Additionally, five hydroelectric/multipurpose projects
are proposed in the region. Details are at Annexure.
Further, NHPC Ltd. has undertaken Renovation & Modernization (R&M) works of Loktak
power station (105 MW) in Manipur.

records.title: NATIONAL SPORTS UNIVERSITY IN MANIPUR.
details: a: A Search cum Selection committee has also been constituted by the Central Government for recommending a panel of names out of the applicants, for the purpose of selection of the Vice- Chancellor in National Sports University, Imphal, Manipur.
